title: Tara learns letter L from a lemon... what letter did she miss before?
title_alts: Letter L from lemon, look and learn
Miss letter L and lemons go wrong
description_hook: Learn the letter L with a bright yellow lemon, one sound at a time, with simple Hindi captions.

characters.name: Tara
characters.description: age four, black hair in two small puffs, red dress, yellow lemon in hand
